description:
'''Bullerengue''' is a traditional & old musical genre and dance from the [[Caribbean region of Colombia]] and the [[Darién Province]] in [[Panama]] In Central America. It is sung and preserved primarily by elderly women or does of old age, accompanied by local artisan drums, and developed in the Palenques or Maroon communities.

Bullerengue continues to be practiced along [[Caribbean region of Colombia|Colombia’s Caribbean]] coast, particularly in rural [[Afro-Colombians|Afro-Colombian]] communities. It is commonly performed at local festivals, family events, and community celebrations. Although the genre was historically transmitted informally, recent academic research and cultural initiatives have brought increased recognition to bullerengue and its performers.
